limitations: The sample is very small (n=6 rows with coordinates; 4 with a role source). The median percentile and the Mann–Whitney U p-value have weak statistical power; read them only as a consistency check, not as proof.
Regions are unbalanced: US-SW 4, HAW 1, ANA 1, ATA (Atacama) 0. There is no positive control for Atacama; the ranking of Atacama candidates was not tested this way.

Only 3 of the coordinates come from USGS GNIS (SP Crater, Meteor Crater, Amboy). Salda: NASA EO Explorer map centre. HI-SEAS and MDRS coordinates come from Wikipedia or have no citation (weak source).
Some known analogs were chosen for reasons other than landform (access, geochemistry, logistics); a missed analog alone does not mean the method is wrong (SPEC 7.1).

Even if the success target (median percentile <= 20%) were met with this n, we would not say 'method validated'; we would say 'no contradiction was found in this small sample'. If it is not met, the reason is discussed separately.
positive_control.interpretation_rule: Results are always reported with n and the region split; if no confidence interval can be given (n too small), that is stated too.

lunar_reference_windows_note: Site07 is ~36 km from the pole: the full LOLA run window is read pole-centred at >= 80x80 km (test: 40x40 km was not enough).
